title: Commit-Bound Proof Receipt (Candidate Schema)
description: Candidate formal JSON Schema for Agent Factory promotion proof receipts, extending staging-prove core fields with independent reviewer attestation, cross-model diversity, and negative-routing checks.

run_id.description: Unique factory run identifier matching X-Factory-Run git trailer.

target_commit_sha.description: Canonical 40-character lowercase hexadecimal Git commit SHA proven at branch tip.

status.description: Verification verdict; promotion gates require PASS.

staging_host.description: Explicit staging host URL or identifier when proof_mode is staging.

replay_command.description: Exact deterministic verification or test command executed against target_commit_sha.

exit_code.description: Process exit code; promotion gates require integer 0 (non-boolean).

author_id.description: Agent or developer identity that authored target_commit_sha.

reviewer_id.description: Independent adversarial reviewer identity; must differ from author_id.

author_model_family.description: Model family of author_id for cross-model diversity checks.

reviewer_model_family.description: Model family of reviewer_id; cross-model policy requires distinct family from author_model_family.

tier.description: Execution tier selected under run-spec negative-routing rules.

negative_route_checked.description: Explicit flag confirming run-spec negative-routing criteria were evaluated.
